verdict.rationale: Render explicitly advertises deploying 'reliable agents and background processes at scale, without wiring up queues, workers, and retry logic' (render-docs-5), which supports autonomous background automation, and it also has a CLI/REST API for setup (render-docs-14, render-docs-15). However, there's no explicit mention of scheduled/cron jobs, triggers, or AI-specific automation workflows, and no hands-on evidence of this working for autonomous agent tasks. Missing for 10: explicit cron/scheduled job docs, AI-specific automation examples, independent hands-on verification of background agent reliability.
